identity.name: Inbox  Entry Point for Ideas and Tasks
identity.description: The inbox is the entry point for all new ideas and tasks. It serves as a buffer zone before content is processed and moved to appropriate honeycombs.

meta.purpose: The inbox is the entry point for all new ideas and tasks. It acts as a buffer before content is processed and distributed to permanent honeycombs.
meta.lifecycle: Items in the inbox are read at the start of each session. After processing, they are moved to the appropriate target honeycombs (e.g., tasks/, roadmaps/, seeds/) and removed from inbox.

rules.read_on_start: External SR MUST read inbox contents at session start to be aware of pending tasks.
rules.file_lifecycle: Files in inbox are temporary. After the task is completed or the idea is realized, the file is moved to the corresponding permanent honeycomb (tasks/, roadmaps/, seeds/, etc.) and deleted from inbox.
rules.who_adds: Gardener or External SR may add files to inbox. Format must be valid JSON with identity and content sections.
rules.format: All files must be valid JSON with identity and content sections.
